name: Inquisitor's Trap silences the first enemy to approach it and all enemies within 5 yd (#783)
contract: Inquisitor's Trap 681445 (installed Spell.dbc) is a 60000 ms cooldown SUMMON of creature 506251 in front of the caster (TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT), duration index 3 = 60 s; its silence helper 681447 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE (27) with duration index 32 = 6000 ms and radius index 8 = 5 yd. Tooltip: 'Place a cruel trap on the ground lasting 1 min that will curse the first enemy to approach it silencing them and all enemies in a 5 yd radius for 6 sec.' The behaviour is not in Spell.dbc alone: spell_script_names binds 681445 to spell_ascension_witch_hunter_summon and creature_template 506251 to npc_ascension_witch_hunter_field (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp), whose AI polls every 250 ms for a valid enemy within 3 yd, casts 681447 on every valid enemy within 5 yd of it and despawns. The fixture layout does not depend on the player's facing: enemy a stands on the caster (2 yd from a trap dropped 2 yd in front of it, so within the 3 yd trigger radius), enemy b 3 yd from the caster (at most 3 yd from a, inside the 5 yd silence radius whether it or a triggers the trap) and enemy c 9 yd away (more than 5 yd from both). All are level-60 hostile dummies and the hunter has spell hit rating 10000.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: the far enemy is 9 yards away
Drop Inquisitor's Trap in front of the hunter
The first enemy in reach is silenced
An enemy within 5 yd of it is silenced too
An enemy 9 yd away is not
The silence lasts at most 6 seconds
